newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia's Uhispank gets IFC loan.
newsitem.headline: Estonia's Uhispank gets IFC loan.

text.p: Major Estonian bank, Union Bank, said on Friday that it has signed a loan deal with the International Finance Corp, part of the World Bank, for a 10 million mark credit line.
The funds will be used for lending to Estonian firms for investment needs, Union Bank said in a statement. The loan is over a six-year period.

Union Bank, quoted in Helsinki and on the Tallinn stock exchange, earlier this month anounced a merger with fifth largest bank the North Estonian Bank, which it make the combined company the second bank in the Baltic state.
